# Test: Rollback from split-rootfs v2 back to split-rootfs v1
# Scenario: split(v2) -> split(v1) rollback
#
# Precondition: device was updated split(v1) -> split(v2) via
#   update_split_to_split test. Both partition slots contain
#   split-rootfs images.
#
# This test pushes the first split-rootfs version again and verifies:
# - Device reverts to the previous split-rootfs version
# - Extension paired with the reverted slot loads correctly
# - extsloader reaches "ready" state
# - dm-verity root hash is present
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION  - first split-rootfs EVE version tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

# First split-rootfs version to roll back to
{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}

# Default EVE registry
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

# Obtain EVE_VERSION from environment
{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

# Obtain EVE_REGISTRY from environment (e.g. "myuser/eve")
{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# Decrease update testing time
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=30

# Send update back to first split-rootfs version
message 'Split->Split rollback: sending update request'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$eve_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# Wait for update to complete (active on original partition)
message 'Split->Split rollback: waiting for rollback to activate...'
{{$test}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

# Verify split-rootfs specific state on rolled-back version
message 'Split->Split rollback: verifying Extension loaded...'

# extsloader state must be ready
eden eve ssh 'cat /run/extsloader-state.json'
stdout '"state":"ready"'

# Extension image must exist on persist
eden eve ssh 'ls /persist/ext-img*.img'
stdout 'ext-img'

# dm-verity root hash must be present
eden eve ssh 'test -f /etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo present || echo missing'
stdout 'present'

# Extension filesystem must be mounted
eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

message 'Split->Split rollback: SUCCESS'

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}
